title: [Papyrus app shell] Private sites: Amplify build verifies the `leftblock/ci` status for $AWS_COMMIT_ID before deploying
description:
Repo: AnthusAI/Papyrus. Files: `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/site-config.ts` (new `ci` field), `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts`, `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/amplify-app-shell.ts`, tests, `features/`, `docs/site-hosting.md`.

Why here: branch protection needs GitHub Pro for private repos (403 today), so the enforcement point is the deploy. A failed gate costs <1 build-minute instead of a 12-minute red build.
Design:
- `site.json`: `"ci": { "gate": "actions" | "leftblock-receipt", "statusContext": "leftblock/ci", "requireSignature": false }`. Validation: `autoDeploy: true` requires `gate: actions`; private repos (auto-build on) require `gate: leftblock-receipt`.
- `cmsProductionBuildSpec` (and reader spec) for `leftblock-receipt`: FIRST backend command (before `npm ci`) = a small POSIX shell gate: read a GitHub token from the app's existing repository access secret (`repositoryAccessTokenSecretArn`) or an SSM SecureString `/papyrus/<siteId>/github-status-token` (generated by IaC, never manual), `curl -fsS https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/$AWS_COMMIT_ID/status`, require `.statuses[] | select(.context=="leftblock/ci") | .state == "success"` (jq is on the Amplify image; fall back to grep/sed if not). On failure print "No LeftBlock CI receipt for $AWS_COMMIT_ID: run `leftblock ci` and push again" and exit 1. Optional signature check: `pipx run leftblock verify-ci --status-only --require-signature` when `requireSignature` is set (secret from SSM).
- Grant the compute/build role `ssm:GetParameter` + `kms:Decrypt` for that parameter only.
Acceptance: unit tests for the generated spec; CDK diff shows only the build spec + IAM change; Gherkin "private site build without receipt stops before npm ci"; "with success status it deploys". Deploy of the app-shell stacks for dataparade and papyrus-web happens in the adoption story.
